summary: Android audio-device refresh now keeps a selectable system output when both the WebRTC and native communication-device lists are empty. The same merge/fallback path is used for initial enumeration and device-change events. An async native scan is ignored after its AppState has been disposed.

checks.name: Android empty device-change regression
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub test/app_state_test.dart --plain-name 'keeps Android system output available after an empty device-change scan'
checks.observation: The regression reproduced the missing system output before the implementation change. After the fix, the device-change scan retains the selectable 'Системный динамик' fallback.

checks.name: AppState and Android audio device test suites
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub test/app_state_test.dart test/android_audio_devices_test.dart
checks.observation: All 44 tests passed, including route enumeration, selection, Android additions, stale scan protection, system-output fallback, and AppState lifecycle handling.

checks.name: Physical Android hotplug and route switching
checks.observation: ADB reported no attached Android device; Flutter listed macOS and Chrome only. USB/Bluetooth hotplug and audible route switching were not tested.

remaining: Test USB/Bluetooth hotplug and audible route switching during an active call on physical Android, macOS and Windows devices. Confirm pre-Android-12 system-default output behavior on a physical Android device.
